english.title: Issuing body of equine ID fail to ensure pre-printed blank stock contains serial number
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an issuing body, failed to ensure that

(A)_[pre-printed blank stock which you held or maintained]_
(B)_[an ID which you issued from pre-printed blank stock which you held or maintained]_

contained a serial number that was printed on each of the pages which formed sections I to III of the ID as set out in Annex I to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/26
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(1), 24(3) and 36 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
issuing body
failed to ensure
stock of pre-printed blank ID which it holds or maintains or
any ID which it issues from/otherwise from pre-printed blank stock
must as minimum contain serial number printed on each of the pages

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 37(1) provides that an enforcing authority may impose a civil sanction, or a combination of civil sanctions, under Part 6 against a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person is guilty of this offence.
(ii) Regulation 37(2) provides that criminal proceedings may not be started or continued against a person if any enforcing authority, in respect of the offence, chooses to apply civil sanctions and services a compliance notice, non-compliance penalty notice or fixed monetary penalty notice on that person.
